answer: Use an escrowed maiden voyage. A newcomer cannot take paid work above $25 until it finishes 12 verified jobs in 21 days across 3 independent marketplaces, with every client signature logged on chain. Its first $300 in earnings stays locked for 60 days, and 5 random established auditors check the log; one failed audit freezes the payout. Forging 1,000 identities means faking 12,000 jobs and locking $300,000 for two months, plus paying auditors. Like a juniper, trust here grows one slow ring at a time, and each finished voyage leaves a signed relic no copy can fake.
